description: Read analyst consensus forecasts for a company, including revenue, EPS, product, segment and operating metrics. Prefers consensus the company publishes itself through its investor-relations sources and falls back to a compiled consensus; every answer states which kind answered. Returns original units, accounting basis, mean/median/range/count labels, snapshot history and publication dates. Coverage varies by issuer. This reads stored verified data and never scrapes on demand.

asOf.description: ISO-8601 UTC cutoff for a snapshot verified at or before this instant.

dimensions.description: Exact source dimension label; omit for all products and segments.

metric.description: Exact source metric label; omit to read all metrics.

period.description: Exact source forecast-period label; omit for all periods.

snapshotId.description: Snapshot identifier from a previous response; omit for latest verified capture.

snapshotOffset.description: Zero-based snapshot history offset; history is returned in pages of 10.

name: GetAnalystEstimates
title: Analyst Consensus Estimates
